item.title: Why ChatGPT Can't Find Your Business (Yet)
item.description: Most Hull businesses are invisible to AI search. Here's why that matters, and what you can do about it.
item.content:encoded:
Open ChatGPT. Ask it to recommend an IT company in Hull. If your business doesn't appear, you're invisible to a growing segment of customers who've stopped using Google.

AI doesn't show ten blue links. It gives one answer. If you're not in that answer, you don't exist.

GEO is still in its infancy. Early movers will dominate AI search for their niches. Request a free visibility audit.

item.title: MacBook Won't Turn On? When Repair Makes More Sense Than Replace
item.description: When Apple says "unrepairable", there's often a component-level fix available. Here's how to know which option is right for you.
item.content:encoded:
Apple quotes you for a full "logic board replacement." The actual fault? Often a single component that can be sourced for a few pounds.

Under a stereo microscope at 40x magnification, individual chips can be removed, tested, and replaced — saving machines Apple would have you replace.

Request a free diagnosis for an honest assessment.

item.title: WEEE Regulations 2025: What Hull Businesses Need to Know
item.description: New November 2025 WEEE regulations affect how you dispose of e-waste. Here's your compliance checklist.
item.content:encoded:
November 2025 marks a major update to UK e-waste law. The compliance bar is going up with expanded scope, wider producer responsibility, and stricter enforcement.

Improper data disposal is a GDPR breach. The ICO can issue fines up to £17.5 million or 4% of global annual turnover.

Free e-waste collection includes NIST 800-88 data destruction and full compliance documentation.
